observed_source_set_or_exact_safe_equiva.title: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents

claims: The source introduces a scientific data-analysis and visualization agent benchmark with 108 expert-crafted cases organized across application domain, data type, complexity level, and visualization operation.

Its evaluation is outcome-centric and multimodal, combining LLM judging with deterministic checks such as image metrics, code checkers, rule-based verifiers, and case-specific evaluators, with a validity study involving 12 SciVis experts.

evidence.source_qualified_judgment: This benchmark is a useful independent evaluation resource for scientist-agent scanning because it tests realistic multi-step scientific visualization workflows and mixes learned and deterministic outcome checks rather than relying on a single textual judge.

continuation: Next frontier: independently inspect one primary scientific benchmark for literature-retrieval agents, focusing on relation-aware retrieval as a distinct blind spot; persist a new role-local checkpoint/evidence artifact from exactly that source. Phase 1 remains open.
